items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stravinsky, Ravel, Bartok, Prokofiev, Richard Strauss, people of that era.

ctx.x: And will always be. I began to listen to Stravinsky’s other works. Then I became aware of Ravel and Bartok and became a real addict of these persons in particular: Stravinsky, Ravel, Bartok, Prokofiev, Richard Strauss, people of that era. I must have five different recordings of Le Sacre [Le Sacre du Printemps by Igor Stravinsky]. I must have five different recorded versions of [Johnson sings the opening measures of the Firebird Suite by Stravinsky].
